title: Static publishing site + companion dataset export (CC-BY) + corrections/erratum changelog
context: The publishing site is where budget and contracts explainers become accessible to residents, journalists, students, and officials. It must be fast, accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA), and offline-friendly, and ship a machine-readable Frictionless Tabular Data Package companion dataset alongside each explainer so readers can verify and reuse the numbers. A public corrections/erratum changelog is a hard requirement so any figure error is corrected transparently within the SLA. This implements the site/ and publishing layer from PLAN.md. Depends on content-011.
objective: Implement the static publishing site (site/) and companion dataset export pipeline: an accessible, fast, offline-friendly static site (Astro/Eleventy) that publishes explainers with their fiscal year, data sources, snapshot date, and 'describes published open data; not advice; not an audit' label — plus a Frictionless Tabular Data Package companion dataset per explainer (CC-BY-4.0) and a public corrections/erratum changelog.
acceptanceCriteria: Static site built with an accessible static-site generator (Astro or Eleventy) that is fast and offline-friendly

Each explainer displays its fiscal year, data sources, snapshot date, and a 'describes published open data; not financial/legal advice; not an audit' label with a 'verify it yourself' link to the companion dataset
Frictionless Tabular Data Package companion dataset exported alongside each explainer under CC-BY-4.0, containing all source figures with provenance
Public corrections/erratum changelog is live: any figure correction is logged, the affected explainer and dataset are re-issued, and the change is visible to readers
Staleness handling: each explainer carries its fiscalYear and validUntil; when superseded, the explainer auto-banners as superseded and links to the current version
PR merged with green CI and maintainer review passed
output: A merged PR containing the static publishing site (site/) with accessible explainer pages, Frictionless Tabular Data Package companion dataset export (CC-BY-4.0), staleness/superseded bannering, and a public corrections/erratum changelog.
